metadata.description: Small, tested Claude Code plugins: hand-off integrity, hidden acceptance tests, worktree cleanup, memory routing, MCP health, long-run state.

plugins.name: owner-words
plugins.description: Prefixes Agent/SendMessage hand-offs with the user's latest words, verbatim, so subagents know who decided what.

plugins.name: holdouts
plugins.description: Hidden acceptance scenarios: a build route, a validator agent that uses the app like a user, and a guard that keeps scenarios from builders.

plugins.name: worktree-cleanup
plugins.description: Removes git worktrees whose work is clean, pushed, unlocked and not in use, after a git push and at session end.

plugins.name: prompt-router
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that injects the best-matching lines of your MEMORY.md index, with optional local embeddings via Ollama.

plugins.name: mcp-health
plugins.description: A `mcp-health` command that checks every MCP server Claude Code knows about, with an ignore list and optional proxy check.

plugins.name: long-run
plugins.description: STATE.md discipline for long unattended runs, with PreCompact/SessionStart hooks that carry it across context compaction.

plugins.name: references-first
plugins.description: Skill: collect real references and agree the design direction with the user before building anything visual.

plugins.name: skill-step-check
plugins.description: Skill: find out which step of an inconsistent skill varies by splitting it into steps and comparing runs.
